title: Convert Network kit to the style-picker model (schema 2 manifest, dials, accents, Looks)
detail:
Plan step 9 for Network kit: (1) manifest to schema 2 declaring today's four dials supported with THEME_LOOK defaults (owners see no change); (2) register, accent swatches, type voice, motion, hero/header/footer variants, image treatment, Looks, theme dials as the style system allows; (3) functions table mapping existing blocks to the twelve functions; conformance suite green before any dial flips to supported. NEEDS FROM DANIEL: Updated Network style system: dials that vary, accent set, type voices, 4 to 6 Looks, picker kits.

Uses the existing Network design by Daniel's direction. Its four shipped schemes are swatches and Looks, the four existing layout defaults stay in place, and the theme maps its existing blocks to the shared functions. The live picker probe exercises the shipped resolver and was repaired with Daniel's approval.

verify.cmd: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings --import ./scripts/probe-ts.mjs scripts/probes/style-picker-theme.mjs network-kit soft airy bar full marigold coral ocean lagoon
